حقوق، انصاف، کردار، ثقافت اور کائنات کا نظام، یہ سب مل کر ایک مکمل زندگی کی تصویر بناتے ہیں۔
options: The person who stands firm on their character eventually succeeds.
Rights, justice, character, culture, and the universe's system, all these together build the picture of a complete life.
Whoever values their own culture and respects others' culture is the truly great person.
In a village there was an old tradition that the first part of every new harvest was given to the poor.
exercises.translit: Huqūq, insāf, kirdār, saqāfat aur kāināt kā nizām, yeh sab mil kar ek mukammal zindagī kī tasvīr banāte hain.

exercises.prompt: Rights, justice, character, culture, and the universe's system, all these together build the picture of a complete life.
جو انسان اپنے فرض کو پورا کرتا ہے، سچائی سے رہتا ہے اور دوسروں کا احترام کرتا ہے، وہی سچا کامیاب انسان ہے۔
options: A very difficult time came upon a woman and everyone left her.
The court's job is to separate truth from lies.
The country whose institutions are strong, that country is also strong.
The person who fulfills their duty, lives with truthfulness, and respects others, is the truly successful person.
exercises.translit: Jo insān apne farz ko pūrā kartā hai, sachāī se rahtā hai aur dūsrõ kā ehtirām kartā hai, vahī sachā kāmyāb insān hai.

options: The nation that values its traditions and also adopts new thinking progresses the most.
Unity between man and nature is the true sign of progress.
The person who learns from nature understands life much better.
Knowledge, determination, and love, these are the things every new generation should carry forward.
